| Language | Path | Consumer |
|---|---|---|
| Elixir | [`elixir/`](./elixir) | `{:origins_sdk, github: "Source-of-Origins/origins_sdk", sparse: "elixir"}` |

## Regenerated by

`mix origins_sdk.release` in the Origins repo, or the **SDK Release** GitHub Actions workflow there. Do not edit by hand.
